payload.gloss: a new version of an entity that names one or more of its current heads and replaces them; naming a record that is not a head is refused, so a single branch's history stays linear and divergence arises only from merges. It is how an entity evolves, how a withdrawn entity is reinstated, and, naming several heads, how divergence is reconciled.
